adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, legacy host values are split from the site_settings 'embeddable_hosts' string and directly interpolated into raw SQL: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. If any legacy value `h` contains a single quote (or other SQL-special characters), it will break the INSERT (and also constitutes SQL injection risk during migration). The diff shows no escaping/quoting via connection.quote or bind params.
